summary: All 11 screens implemented and building. The verified=true payment gate is correctly enforced in CheckoutNotifier with a named test for the verified=false failure path. No hardcoded localhost/127.0.0.1 URLs or PayPal secrets in Flutter code. API shapes align with backend schemas. APK builds (192MB, app-debug.apk exists). 18 tests passing. Five non-blocking findings: GoRouter deep-link scheme wiring unverified on device, ProductResult UUID exposed before db.commit(), ProductResultResponse.currency is non-optional in schema but ORM column is now nullable (will fail for history/transaction endpoints on null-currency rows), ProductComparisonScreen uses bare Text instead of EmptyStateWidget, and four test coverage gaps (HistoryScreen, ProductSearchScreen, UNKNOWN banner, productResultId fallback).
findings: GoRouter deep link gap: GoRouter has no deepLinkTransformer for proofbuy:// URIs. AndroidManifest intent-filter is correct but GoRouter routing of proofbuy://checkout/return to /checkout/return is unverified on device. Verify with: adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'proofbuy://checkout/return'

ProductResult UUID pre-commit race: RankedProduct.id is str(product_row.id) before await db.commit(). A mid-batch commit failure leaves the client holding UUIDs for non-persisted rows; subsequent checkout returns 404. Fix: commit per-row or return id only after successful commit.

ProductResultResponse.currency non-optional mismatch: currency is str (non-optional) in ProductResultResponse but the ORM column is now nullable after removing the 'USD' default. Any null-currency row serialized via ProductResultResponse (history/transactions endpoints) will raise a Pydantic validation error. Fix: change schema field to Optional[str] = None.

ProductComparisonScreen missing EmptyStateWidget: empty-products path renders Center(child: Text('No products found.')) instead of the shared EmptyStateWidget. Replace with EmptyStateWidget(icon: Icons.search_off, message: 'No products found.').

Test coverage gaps: CheckoutScreen productResultId fallback path (GoRouterState.extra is null) untested; PurchaseReviewScreen UNKNOWN banner untested; HistoryScreen and ProductSearchScreen have no widget tests at all.
